searchText: In mumbai, I believe you mentioned not having the headvotes in the block (given they are also not rewarded). Is this still reasonable? > Round vs epoch I think it still makes sense to use round, but have the round be equal to an epoch (32 slots) and then reduce this in future forks for faster finality Well.. headvotes in a block serve 2 purposes - Vew merge for fork choice proposer view - Trustless payment on chain I think view merge is important, ill ask Francesco later. We know we def do not want old head votes, that's just a pain to deal with. That would only be used for trustless payment > FG attestation uses 1 leaf per round. Voting target -> timeout in the same round reuses the leaf and exposes the key. Fix attestation field to use slot/epoch? I think here we can reserve an extra leaf for the timeout vote. This seems like it would fit into our current strategy for having multiple duties per epoch/slot/round > I think here we can reserve an extra leaf for the timeout vote. timeout could be different branches of the same height as well I think *round* works, not *height*. An attester only perform once per round. I think we are good there

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content: In mumbai, I believe you mentioned not having the headvotes in the block (given they are also not rewarded). Is this still reasonable?

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
> Round vs epoch

I think it still makes sense to use round, but have the round be equal to an epoch (32 slots) and then reduce this in future forks for faster finality

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
Well.. headvotes in a block serve 2 purposes
- Vew merge for fork choice proposer view
- Trustless payment on chain

I think view merge is important, ill ask Francesco later.
We know we def do not want old head votes, that's just a pain to deal with. That would only be used for trustless payment

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
> FG attestation uses 1 leaf per round. Voting target -> timeout in the same round reuses the leaf and exposes the key.  Fix attestation field to use slot/epoch?

I think here we can reserve an extra leaf for the timeout vote. This seems like it would fit into our current strategy for having multiple duties per epoch/slot/round

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
> I think here we can reserve an extra leaf for the timeout vote.
timeout could be different branches of the same height as well
I think *round* works, not *height*. An attester only perform once per round. I think we are good there
